Got clued in and caught up on this whole thing last night, well done everyone, that was a LOT of impressive work.  Having just done an online puzzle hunt with friends late last year---I highly P&A magazine and its recent Puzzle Boat 3, which included 100+ puzzles, the answers for which players had to group into 9 metas, the answers to which formed one glorious meta-meta), this was really awesome to see.

By the way, one thing missing from the wiki entry (I think) is Foote's analysis to get the FtAdamant address.  It looks like it had something to do with strange characters in the code on the Absolute Zero therapy page?  Which I guess must have been the significance of the editor's note that indicated "Character introduced in #128"---maybe size 128 was the size needed to see FtAdamant?  (See: http://greaterthangames.com/comment/125792#comment-125792)

I guess the fonts in INTERVENE are still a nagging thread.  Strange they wouldn't have been a part of some solution at the time, let alone by now---maybe they were a hint towards something you all managed to get done without the hint, though.  Anyway, again, fantastic thread!
